entities.summary: Margaret (Margarethe) Michaelis-Sachs was an Austrian-Australian photographer of Polish-Jewish origin. In addition to her many portraits, her scenes of the Spanish Civil War in Barcelona and other places and her images of the Jewish quarter in Kraków in the 1930s are of lasting historical interest.
